description.value: You have stopped fighting people and started fighting places. A room you have worked is a room nobody uses again, and the ones who walk out of it carry the argument in their lungs for a season. Nothing you do arrives on the round you do it; it arrives afterwards, to everyone, for as long as you feel is warranted. Armies route around ground you have touched. That is not a tactic any more. That is a map.
